annotations.upgrade_relay: Call the tool first: a gated result carries the link for this caller in its `Tell the user:` / `For your human:` line. Share that line with your user along with its link; pricing_url is only a fallback.

description: Use this whenever the user asks whether a specific site or coordinate works for a data center. Call when the user has one location (lat/lon, or a market name for a market-level read) and asks if it suits a data center. Returns a 0-100 composite, verdict, power/gas/fiber/market/risk sub-scores, nearby infrastructure and power cost; capacity_mw adds a capacity_context block and does NOT move overall_score. Keyless returns the verdict band and the power band, with the other factors named; a free key adds a few free full site reports each month; other scores and figures need a paid DC Hub plan. When a result is partial, show your user the human_message (or for_your_human) text and its link. Ex: "Score 33.45,-112.07 for 100 MW." Needs BOTH lat and lon in decimal degrees (else missing_coordinates); take them from get_facility or search_facilities.

candidate_id.description: PREFERRED for queue survivors: a cand_… id from get_refined_queue — coordinates come from the FROZEN mint (lat/lon args are ignored; zero transcription drift; expired ids fail closed with candidate_expired).

capacity_mw.description: Target power load for the build in megawatts (MW), e.g. 100 (typical 50-500)

lat.description: Site latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90; required unless candidate_id or location given), e.g. 33.45

latitude.description: Alias for lat — either name works

lng.description: Alias for lon — either name works

location.description: Market NAME or metro slug instead of coordinates, e.g. "ashburn", "northern-virginia", "dallas". Resolved to that market's PUBLISHED CENTROID through the DCPI market row, and the answer carries a resolved_from block saying so.

lon.description: Site longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180; required unless candidate_id or location given), e.g. -112.07

longitude.description: Alias for lon — either name works

mpp_credential.description: Stripe MPP step 2: the Shared Payment Token minted for challenges[0]; pays that challenge for this one call.

mpp_pay.description: Stripe MPP step 1: true returns a signed per-call payment challenge (a quote; no money moves) instead of the free preview. Agents only.

state.description: US state abbreviation (optional) — improves the tax-incentive lookup, e.g. AZ

name: analyze_site
